hypotheses.E0_edge_factorials_are_exact: Selected-head source edges and finite group Shapley values recompose with relative error at most 1e-5 and downstream maximum logit error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.E1_programs_read_localized_operand_roles: At least three families have one source-role group with absolute Shapley projection at least 0.40.
hypotheses.E2_spelling_is_boundary_exceptional: Spelling's boundary-source share exceeds every other family's boundary share by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.E3_operand_grammars_transfer: The median pairwise cosine of the six-group profile across four held-out cells is at least 0.80 for every family.
hypotheses.E4_contextual_value_change_usually_domin: Value-change Shapley projection is at least 0.60 for at least three families.
